## Summary

A clear and concise description of the idea.

What problem does this solve? Why is it useful?

If you have a specific approach in mind, outline it here.

## Alternatives considered (optional)

Other solutions or workarounds you’ve tried.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps evaluate the request.
